_comment: Profile parameters for The Relay stand-in model service. Every value is sourced to a real probe or explicitly marked ASSUMPTION per Hard Rule 1.

rate_limits.in_flight_concurrency_source: ASSUMPTION: recommended concurrency cap for smooth latency under 8000 TPM
rate_limits.daily_requests_budget_source: ASSUMPTION: estimated 24h capacity at typical free tier headroom

latency_distribution_ms.inter_token_delay_source: probe:derived from token streaming output rate
latency_distribution_ms.simulated_failure_rate_source: ASSUMPTION: 3% transient network glitch rate for resilience testing
